name: DaxLib.SVG.Attr.Shapes
description: Generates a STRING of common shape attributes that can be passed to `DaxLib.SVG.Element.*` or `DaxLib.SVG.Def.*` functions

parameters.name: fill
parameters.description: Fill color or gradient reference. Omitted if not specified

parameters.name: fillOpacity
parameters.description: Fill opacity (0-1). Omitted if not specified

parameters.name: fillRule
parameters.description: Fill rule ("nonzero" or "evenodd"). Omitted if not specified

parameters.name: stroke
parameters.description: Stroke color. Omitted if not specified

parameters.name: strokeWidth
parameters.description: Stroke width. Omitted if not specified

parameters.name: strokeOpacity
parameters.description: Stroke opacity (0-1). Omitted if not specified

parameters.name: opacity
parameters.description: Overall opacity (0-1). Omitted if not specified

return_description: An attribute string that can be used directly in SVG elements
code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Attr.Shapes' =
		(
			fill: STRING = BLANK(),
			fillOpacity: DOUBLE = BLANK(),
			fillRule: STRING = BLANK(),
			stroke: STRING = BLANK(),
			strokeWidth: INT64 = BLANK(),
			strokeOpacity: DOUBLE = BLANK(),
			opacity: DOUBLE = BLANK()
		) =>

			IF( NOT ISBLANK( fill ),          "fill='" & fill & "' ") &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( fillOpacity ),   "fill-opacity='" & fillOpacity & "' ") &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( fillRule ),      "fill-rule='" & fillRule & "' ") &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( stroke ),        "stroke='" & stroke & "' ") &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( strokeWidth ),   "stroke-width='" & strokeWidth & "' ") &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( strokeOpacity ), "stroke-opacity='" & strokeOpacity & "' ") &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( opacity ),       "opacity='" & opacity & "' ")
